title: Implement Proof-of-Possession Operator Attestor and KMS Leak Detector
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Adds an attestation-based operator attestor service, RBAC revocation hook, KMS usage leak detector, and audit enrichment. Backwards-compatible rollout with staged canary and feature flag.
body:
Summary: This PR introduces a new attestation-backed service (operator-attestor) that verifies proof-of-possession for operator sessions, enriches audit logs with attestation metadata and residency context, and plugs into a KMS usage leak detector to surface anomalous key consumption patterns. Motivation: After a recent operational postmortem (Linear ENG-4120) we found gaps in operator session validation and slow detection of abnormal KMS usage that complicated incident response. This change reduces blast radius from compromised operator credentials by requiring a short-lived attestation token and by flagging suspicious cross-region or high-throughput KMS activity.

What changed (high level):
- New service: /services/operator-attestor (Go)
  - Accepts attestation assertions from operator clients (TPM/secure element/YubiKey), verifies signatures and nonce freshness, and returns a signed ephemeral attestation token (1m TTL).
  - Exposes a gRPC health endpoint and a small admin UI to inspect recent attestation verdicts.
- RBAC v2 integration:
  - Added an authn hook that requires proof-of-possession attestation for operator-level roles when the feature flag 'attest.operator.enabled' is on.
  - Implemented a revocation path: the attestor can emit revocation events to the authz cache to immediately drop sessions tied to a failed attestation or leak signal.
- KMS Leak Detector (policy engine & telemetry):
  - New detector component subscribes to KMS usage stream and applies heuristics (geo-flux, entropy-of-callsites, sudden-rate-spike) to score suspicious activity.
  - When a score exceeds threshold, we emit an alert, attach the KMS evidence to an audit entry, notify the attestor to kick a revocation run, and surface findings in Console under Security -> KMS Incidents.
- Audit pipeline changes:
  - Audit entries gain new fields: attestation.subject, attestation.issuer, attestation.ttl, residency.region_hint (when present), and kms_detection.score.
  - Audit forwarder sanitizes attestation blobs for PII while retaining verification fingerprints for forensic replay.
- Data residency and region pinning:
  - KMS detector respects tenant residency constraints; cross-region usage is scored more aggressively and tagged for manual review.
- Feature flags & rollout:
  - All runtime hooks behind feature flags: attest.operator.enabled, kms.detector.mode (off | monitor | enforce).
  - Staged rollout plan: monitor-only for 1 week in us-west, then canary to 5% traffic, then full enforcement.

Implementation notes / commits (summary):
- commit 1: scaffolding for operator-attestor service, proto definitions, and CI jobs.
- commit 2: attestation verifier implementation (TPM + PKI chains + nonce replay protection).
- commit 3: RBAC hook and authz cache integration; small API change to authn middleware.
- commit 4: KMS leak detector module (stream consumer, scoring engine, alert adapter).
- commit 5: audit enrichment and forwarder changes (serializer and sanitizer).
- commit 6: console UI additions and docs and migration + tests and feature flag wiring.

Files changed (high level):
- services/operator-attestor/* (new)
- internal/authn/attestation_hook.go (new)
- internal/authz/cache_invalidator.go (mod)
- services/kms-detector/* (new)
- internal/audit/enricher.go (mod)
- telemetry/alerts/kms_alert_adapter.go (new)
- web/console/src/pages/security/kms-incidents.tsx (mod)
- docs/security/operator-attestation.md (new)
- deploy/helm/operator-attestor-values.yaml (new)
- test/integration/attestor_e2e_test.go (new)

Backward compatibility:
- All auth changes are behind feature flags; default behavior unchanged. Audit schema is additive and backwards compatible (new fields optional). KMS detector can be set to monitor mode which does not trigger revocations.

Testing and CI:
- Unit tests for verifier, detector scoring, and audit sanitizer added.
- Integration test runs that spin up attestor and a mock KMS telemetry stream were added; tests marked flaky on small runners and configured for retry (we observed one intermittent TPM simulator failure and added a 3s backoff in the harness).
- CI summary: initial pipeline failed on integration flakiness (test: TestAttestorNonceReplay) due to simulator timing; rerun succeeded. All checks green on final run. CI jobs added: attestor-lint, attestor-unit, attestor-integration (parallel), kms-detector-unit, audit-compat-check.

Review conversation (high level):
- Lucas Rivera: "Can the attestation token be rotated to a shorter TTL in enforcement mode? Also please ensure replay cache sharding scales with operator count." — Reply (Priya): "Yes, TTL is configurable via feature flag and the replay cache supports consistent hashing across shards; added comments and metrics (attestor.replay_cache.hit/miss)."
- Avery Nguyen: "KMS detector heuristics look promising, but are we generating too many false positives for tenants with bursty workloads?" — Reply (Priya): "Added tenant-level quiet windows and adaptive thresholds; detector operates in monitor mode by default and tracks false positive rate metric kms.detector.fpr to tune thresholds."
- Michael Chen: "Audit enrichment is good; ensure we scrub attestation blobs before external forwarding to log sinks to avoid leaking device identifiers." — Reply (Priya): "Scrubbing implemented with a whitelist of verification fingerprints; attestation.raw removed unless admin opt-in is set. Documented in docs/security/operator-attestation.md."
- Security review (SEC-89): Accept with minor tweaks; requested logging of why a revocation event fired (added kms_detector.reason field to audit).
- SRE: requested HPA and resource limits for operator-attestor; added helm values and autoscaling policy suggested in deploy/helm/*.

Rollout plan and mitigations:
- Phase 0: deploy operator-attestor in monitor-only mode (attest.operator.enabled = false) to gather telemetry and warm replay caches.
- Phase 1 (week 1): enable attest.operator.enabled true for us-west control plane with kms.detector.mode=monitor.
- Phase 2 (canary): enable detector enforce for small subset and set auto-revoke to false to validate false positives.
- Phase 3 (enforce): enable automatic revocation and scale to full fleet once FPR < 1% over 48h.
- Rollback: feature flag toggles allow immediate disable; revocation events are idempotent and carry tombstone markers for manual undo.

Operational runbooks (short):
- If kms.detector.alert spikes: set kms.detector.mode=monitor, investigate top KMS callers via Console KMS Incidents view, correlate with attestation.subject and residency.region_hint.
- If attestor fails health: fallback auth path allows short-term admin sessions (5m) with expedited logging and a PagerDuty alert to oncall.

Dependencies and follow-ups:
- Follow-up: integrate attestation-based session MFA into SDKs (ENG-4205).
- Follow-up: add long-term retention policy for attestation verification fingerprints tied to audits (COMPLIANCE-22).

Why this is different / not covered by previous work: Prior PRs focused on KMS scoping, residency tagging, and audit forwarding. This PR couples operator session proof-of-possession attestation with a KMS usage detector and a direct RBAC revocation hook to close the control loop between detection and mitigation. It also attempts to preserve privacy by scrubbing attestation material before export while retaining forensic fingerprints.

Merge: squash-and-merge. Merged after final sign-off from Security and SRE. Changelog and docs added.

Related: ENG-4120, SEC-89, ENG-4205.
